title: The kbmon-pane mod gives no receipt after /clear, /resume or /branch until the alert set changes
goal: after /clear, /resume or /branch resets the mod's state, the next refresh appends the kbmon receipt line again even when the alert set is unchanged

run: import sys;t=open('.claude/skills/kbmon-pane/hooks/register.tsx',encoding='utf-8').read();sys.exit(0 if ('SessionStart' in t and 'lastAlerts = null' in t) else 1)

repro_reason: the mod runs only inside an interactive Claude Code session; no headless command drives /clear and the pane refresh, so the repro reads that the hooks module resets lastAlerts on a session reset
